intent: A binary on/off switch with an accessible label; supports a mixed (indeterminate) state.
use_when: Toggling a single setting on/off in place.
You need an indeterminate (mixed) state across a multi-selection.
dont_use_when: Choosing among options — use RadioButton / SegmentedControl.
A form checkmark reads better — use Checkbox.

a11y.label: aria-label from the required label prop
